014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.util.Collection;
017import java.util.Objects;
018import java.util.Optional;
019
020import java.util.function.BiFunction;
021import java.util.function.Function;
022
023public final class ExperimentalFunctions {
024
025  private ExperimentalFunctions() {
026    super();
027  }
028
029  /**
030   * Returns a {@link BiFunction} that will resolve dependencies.
031   *
032   * @param <E> the type of thing the returned dependency resolver can resolve dependencies for; normally something
033   * (such as a {@link javax.lang.model.element.VariableElement} or {@link java.lang.reflect.Parameter} or {@link
034   * java.lang.reflect.Field} or similar) representing a field or an executable's parameter
035   *
036   * @param bscf a {@link Function} that accepts an argument and returns a suitable {@link BeanSelectionCriteria} (or
037   * {@code null}); must not be {@code null}
038   *
039   * @param optionalCf a {@link BiFunction} that accepts a {@link Creation} and something like a {@link
040   * javax.lang.model.element.VariableElement} and returns a suitable {@link Creation} (almost always the supplied
041   * {@link Creation}, but possibly a different one to account for transient references); may be {@code null}
042   *
043   * @param rs a {@link BiFunction} that accepts a {@link BeanSelectionCriteria} and a {@link Creation} and returns a
044   * resolved dependency, which may be {@code null}; must not be {@code null}; normally {@link
045   * Request#reference(BeanSelectionCriteria, Creation) Request::reference}
046   *
047   * @return a {@link BiFunction} that accepts a key and a {@link Creation} and returns a resolved dependency suitable
048   * for that key; never {@code null}
049   *
050   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code bscf} or {@code rs} is {@code null}
051   */
052  public static final <E> BiFunction<? super E, ? super Creation<?>, ?> dependencyResolver(final Function<? super E, ? extends BeanSelectionCriteria> bscf,
053                                                                                           final BiFunction<? super Creation<?>, ? super E, ? extends Creation<?>> optionalCf,
054                                                                                           final BiFunction<? super BeanSelectionCriteria, ? super Creation<?>, ?> rs) {
055    Objects.requireNonNull(bscf, "bscf");
056    Objects.requireNonNull(rs, "rs");
057    final BiFunction<? super Creation<?>, ? super E, ? extends Creation<?>> cf =
058      optionalCf == null ? ExperimentalFunctions::returnFirstArgument : optionalCf;
059    return (e, c) -> Optional.ofNullable(bscf.apply(e)).map(bsc -> rs.apply(bsc, cf.apply(c, e))).orElseThrow(UnsatisfiedReductionException::new);
060  }
061
062  // (For setting up InvocationContexts for interceptors.)
063  public static final <E> Collection<?> arguments(final Collection<? extends E> es,
064                                                  final Creation<?> c,
065                                                  final BiFunction<? super E, ? super Creation<?>, ?> dr) {
066    return es.stream()
067      .map(e -> dr.apply(e, c))
068      .toList();
069  }
070
071  public static final <E> Object[] argumentsArray(final Collection<? extends E> es,
072                                                  final Creation<?> c,
073                                                  final BiFunction<? super E, ? super Creation<?>, ?> dr) {
074    return arguments(es, c, dr).toArray();
075  }
076
077
078  private static final <X, Y> X returnFirstArgument(final X x, final Y y) {
079    return x;
080  }
081
082}
